groups.source: It is important to note that the client does not retry failed requests when retries are disabled.

groups.source: In this section, we will walk through the fact that the validator rejects the migration if any statement refers to a different database.

groups.unsafe: The validator rejects the migration if every statement refers to a different database.
groups.critical_difference: Any offending statement is sufficient; the unsafe revision requires all statements to offend.

groups.source: The division of responsibilities is as follows: the parser validates syntax, and the scheduler selects the next job.
